description: This file provides utilities for rasterizing PDF documents into PNG images per page, utilizing the PyMuPDF (fitz) library. It defines a data class for page information and a function that processes a PDF file to generate raster images and record their sizes.

classes.name: RasterPageInfo
classes.description: Data class encapsulating metadata about each rasterized page, including index, image path, pixel dimensions, and DPI.

methods.name: Tuple[List[RasterPageInfo],Dict[int,Tuple[float,float]]] rasterize_pdf(pdf_path: Path, out_dir: Path, dpi: int = 300, max_pages: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Rasterizes each page of a given PDF into PNG images at specified DPI and returns information about the rasterized pages along with their sizes in points.

ctags.name: rasterize_pdf
ctags.pattern: /^def rasterize_pdf(pdf_path: Path, out_dir: Path, dpi: int = 300, max_pages: Optional[int] = None/
ctags.signature: (pdf_path: Path, out_dir: Path, dpi: int = 300, max_pages: Optional[int] = None)
